Alma invites those outside the church to be baptized unto repentance and says they may partake of the fruit of the tree of life.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Alma may be shown speaking.
unspecified_visual_details: The setting and the appearance or presence of those addressed are not specified.

spoken_dialogue.text: Come and be baptized unto repentance, that ye also may be partakers of the fruit of the tree of life.
spoken_dialogue.speaker: Alma

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The fruit of the tree of life is part of Alma's invitation, not a tree narrated as physically present.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict a baptism or a literal tree of life as occurring in this scene.
Do not assign a location or invented identities to those addressed.
